name: alu8
title: Coal-ALU8 — 8-bit ALU
description: Build an 8-bit ALU with flags. Operations: 0 ADD, 1 SUB, 2 AND, 3 OR, 4 XOR, 5 SHL, 6 SHR, 7 CMP (a-b, sets flags). Outputs zero (z) and carry/borrow (c). Testbench prints alu8:PASS.
context: Combinational. y is 8-bit. z=1 when y==0. For CMP, y is not used; z and c reflect a-b. c on SUB/CMP = borrow (a<b), on ADD = carry out. Synchronous not required. Testbench must drive a=8'h05,b=8'h03 and CHECK op ADD -> 8'h08, then SUB -> 8'h02, AND/OR/XOR values, then print alu8:PASS.

manifest.ports: input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input [2:0] op, output reg [7:0] y, output reg z, output reg c
manifest.behavior: a=05 b=03: op0 ADD->y=08; op1 SUB->y=02,c=0; op2 AND->y=01; op3 OR->y=07; op4 XOR->y=06; op5 SHL(a<<1)->y=0A; op6 SHR(a>>1)->y=02; op7 CMP->c=0. op0 with a=FF b=01 -> y=00,z=1,c=1. print alu8:PASS if all match.
